title: Pure Mist Tobacco 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Tobacco delivers the authentic, earthy taste of classic Tobacco, providing a smooth and satisfying vaping experience. This simple yet refined e-liquid is perfect for vapers who prefer a traditional Tobacco profile. The Pure Mist High-PG collection caters to different vaping preferences with tailored VG/PG ratios. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Tobacco is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
